draft.text: You came in because you hurt your right knee while playing basketball yesterday.
You said your knee popped when you landed, and you have swelling and pain on the inside of your knee.
We think there might be a tear in your knee, but we need more tests to be sure.
We will schedule an MRI of your knee.
We also want you to get blood tests for your kidneys, blood sugar, and cholesterol.
You should take your diabetes medicine as prescribed.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you hurt your right knee while playing basketball.
You said your knee popped when you landed after getting a rebound.
You have swelling and pain, mostly on the inside of your knee.
We did not do any tests or exams during this visit.
You told us about your symptoms and your medical history.
You may have a knee injury, such as a tear.
We need more information to know for sure.
You will need an MRI of your right knee.
We will talk about your medicines and encourage you to take metformin as prescribed.
You should also schedule blood tests for your kidneys and cholesterol.
We will follow up with you to check on your progress.
